name: io.github.nacho-labs-llc/mcp-semantic-search
description: Local semantic search for AI coding tools. Index decisions, patterns, and context — recall them by meaning, not keywords. Powered by nachos-embeddings (Transformers.js). No API keys, no cloud, no costs.
title: Semantic Search MCP Server

environmentVariables.name: MCP_SEMANTIC_STORE
environmentVariables.description: Path to the JSON file where the index is persisted. Defaults to .semantic-store.json in the working directory.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_SEMANTIC_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Embedding model to use. Defaults to Xenova/all-MiniLM-L6-v2.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_SEMANTIC_PROVIDER
environmentVariables.description: Embedding provider: transformers or bedrock. Defaults to transformers.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_SEMANTIC_BEDROCK_REGION
environmentVariables.description: AWS region for the Bedrock provider. Defaults to us-east-1.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_SEMANTIC_BEDROCK_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Bedrock embedding model ID. Defaults to amazon.titan-embed-text-v2:0.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_SEMANTIC_BEDROCK_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Optional AWS shared-credentials profile name for Bedrock.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_SEMANTIC_BEDROCK_DIMENSIONS
environmentVariables.description: Optional Bedrock embedding dimensions override. Defaults to 1024.
